Who We Are

Atlan is building the context layer for enterprise AI. Enterprises are pouring money into AI and most of it dies in production because the AI does not understand the business context around the data. That is the problem Atlan solves.

Gartner has named context the defining issue in enterprise AI, and calls context graphs the essential infrastructure for AI agents, naming Atlan one of three vendors already building it. We are also the only vendor named a Leader across all four major Gartner and Forrester evaluations for data catalogs, data governance and metadata management, the foundation the context layer runs on.

Come build the infrastructure that AI runs on.

Who We Are

Gartner calls context the defining issue in enterprise AI, and context graphs the essential infrastructure for AI agents. It names Atlan as one of three vendors already building one. We're also the only vendor named a Leader in all four major Gartner and Forrester evaluations for data catalogs, data governance and metadata management, the layer our context graph is built on.

Come build the infrastructure AI runs on.


The Team

You'll join the team building Atlan's context layer, the platforms that make it possible and the vertical agents that run on it. The platform is what any agent needs before an enterprise will trust it: a registry of which agents and skills exist, traces and evals on every run, and governance over cost and access.

Vertical agents each do one specific job, for customers and for Atlan's own teams. Inside Atlan they already run real work. There's an agent our CSMs trust, three GTM agents that replace 3,000 calls made by hand, an agent that watches every page on atlan.com, and one that monitors the other agents. We write up what we learn in the open at Becoming Frontier.

The team works in small "two-slice" units. You own one initiative, usually with one or two people alongside you, and you decide how it gets built.


What will you do?

You'll take problems nobody has fully defined yet and ship working systems, fast. Depending on where you're matched, you may:

  • Own a 0→1 initiative from problem to production. Frame it, write the spec when there isn't one, pick the architecture and build it.

  • Build agents with the people who own the outcome, inside Atlan or at a customer. Scope the workflow with them, demo early and put the agent where the work already happens, like an approval in Slack or a redline in a legal team's Word doc.

  • Earn autonomy with evidence. Start with shadow runs, study the misses and widen what the agent can do as results support it.

  • Design for failure. Decide what happens when a tool is down, context is thin or the agent isn't sure, and how a person takes over.

  • Make the engineering calls on what stays deterministic code and what needs a model, build vs. reuse, model choice, cost and reliability. Explain the trade-offs clearly.

  • Make agent behavior observable. Tie traces and evals to the revision that ran. Track consistency, cost and latency alongside success rate, and treat drift as a regression.

  • Build on and extend the context layer, agent platform and registry: versioned skills, layered instructions, explicit permissions for tools and secrets, and model changes handled as migrations with evals rerun before promotion.

  • Build AI-native yourself. Run coding agents on your own work, keep their skills and instructions up to date, and review what they write for architectural drift.

  • Share what you learn. Turn what works into skills, reference architectures and quality gates that others adopt, and demo what you've built.

What makes you a great match for us?

Must have

  • You've built software systems hands-on and shipped 0→1 products or platforms into production, often without a spec.

  • You've shipped agents or LLM systems that real people use. When one went wrong, you traced it back to the context, tool call or decision that caused it.

  • You use evals to find and fix real problems, check what a score actually counts, and judge agents by user impact: hours saved, error rate or cycle time.

  • You design for failure first: what the agent may touch, what happens when it's wrong, and where a person approves before it acts.

  • You build with coding agents every day and hold what they write to the same bar as your own code.

  • You're a critical optimist. You believe what agents can do is real, and test what still fails before trusting them with more.

  • You reason from first principles. When a familiar design doesn't fit, or a better model makes old scaffolding unnecessary, you notice and rebuild.

  • You have strong systems judgment. You can design for production reliability, latency, cost and security, build it yourself, and leave it in a shape others can build on.

  • You do your best work owning an initiative with one or two people alongside you, and don't need a large team to feel effective.

Strong bonus

  • Experience with MCP, A2A, agent frameworks and runtimes, LLM gateways or agent observability, or you've built an agent harness or orchestration layer yourself.

  • Experience with knowledge graphs, vector search, retrieval or semantic layers.

  • You've built an eval suite from scratch, or run shadow evaluations, LLM grading or staged rollouts.

  • You've shipped agents that write to a system of record, with permissions, approvals and an audit trail.

  • You've led AI adoption inside an engineering or business team and can show the before and after.

  • Founding-engineer, technical-founder or early-stage startup experience, where you built something from nothing.

  • A public trail of work, repos, demos, write-ups or talks, that shows how you build.

This role probably isn't for you if you want to manage a large team, want a well-scoped backlog handed to you, would rather build demos than run agents in production, or are still planning to get into AI.

Why Atlan?

Joining Atlan means being part of a global movement to help data teams do their life’s best work. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive Compensation: We benchmark at the top of the market and keep compensation simple: strong base salary, performance‑based variable pay, and impact‑driven equity (for most roles), so your total rewards grow in step with the value you create over time.

  • AI Native Culture: Atlan is where AI-native builders come to build the systems the future of work will run on. AI isn’t an add-on, it’s woven into how we build, think, and work every day, empowering every Atlanian to move faster and create a bigger impact.

  • Health & Wellness: From Day‑1 health, dental, vision, and mental health to flexible health stipends, we design benefits offerings that lead in each country we're in.

  • Flexible Time Off & Leave Policies: We trust you to own your energy: flexible time off and modern leave so you can unplug properly, support yourself and your loved ones, and come back ready to drive an impact.

  • Accelerated Growth & Learning: Develop at an uncommon velocity through cutting-edge tech, complex implementations, and an experienced team that values mastery.

  • Global, Remote-First, High-Trust: Work from anywhere with a diverse team across 15+ countries, in a trust-first, async environment that gives you true flexibility and ownership over how you work.

More About Us

Atlan is building the shared context layer that enterprises need so AI can operate on trusted, governed context. The conversation has moved from data leaders asking: “Can we trust the data in our stack?” to businesses asking: “Can we trust AI inside the business?”

We are the missing infrastructure for businesses becoming AI-forward - the connective tissue between their data stack, operational systems, and AI agents.

To learn more, visit www.atlan.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Atlan is committed to building an inclusive, diverse, and authentic workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Recruitment Fraud Alert
Your safety is important to us. Be cautious of recruiting emails from domains other than @atlan.com. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links — visit atlan.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

Atlan will never ask candidates to make a payment to apply for or obtain a position. We also will never request financial information, passwords, or other sensitive information from candidates. If you receive a communication that you believe may not be legitimate, do not send money or sensitive information. Please report the same on privacy@atlan.com.

Who We Are

Atlan is building the context layer for enterprise AI. Enterprises are pouring money into AI and most of it dies in production because the AI does not understand the business context around the data. That is the problem Atlan solves.

Gartner has named context the defining issue in enterprise AI, and calls context graphs the essential infrastructure for AI agents, naming Atlan one of three vendors already building it. We are also the only vendor named a Leader across all four major Gartner and Forrester evaluations for data catalogs, data governance and metadata management, the foundation the context layer runs on.

Come build the infrastructure that AI runs on.

Atlan is evolving from a world of apps to a world where apps and AI agents work together. The Agent & App Platform team is building the foundational infrastructure that makes this possible.

We’re looking for a Principal Software Engineer to help set the technical direction for the agent registry and gateway platform.

The Team

The Agent & App Platform team builds the foundations that allow Atlan teams, partners, and customers to build, run, distribute, observe, and govern apps and agents reliably at scale.

You’ll work across areas such as:

  • Agent Registry & Gateways: Systems for registering, discovering, authenticating, governing, and routing agents, tools, and MCP servers.

  • Agent Platform: Shared capabilities for agent execution, including identity, context, secure execution, sessions, checkpointing, and observability.

  • App Runtime: Reliable execution infrastructure built on Kubernetes and Temporal.

  • Distribution & Automation: Packaging, deployment, marketplace experiences, workflows, triggers, templates, and automation capabilities.

What You’ll Do

You’ll own significant technical problems end-to-end and help build the platform primitives powering Atlan’s next generation of apps and agents.

Depending on your strengths and interests, you may:

  • Design and build platform services for agents, tools, and MCP servers, including registries, gateways, authentication, authorization, routing, policy enforcement, audit logging, and tracing.

  • Build the primitives that power agent execution and lifecycle — including templates, marketplace experiences, secure sandboxing, tenant-aware context, durable sessions, checkpointing, and observability.

  • Evolve Atlan’s workflow and runtime infrastructure using Temporal, Kubernetes, and cloud-native technologies, while improving reliability, scalability, performance, and cost.

  • Design and operate multi-tenant distributed systems for enterprise workloads at significant scale, solving complex problems around isolation, failure recovery, capacity, and noisy neighbours.

  • Partner with Product and Engineering teams on how apps and agents come together across registration, distribution, and runtime, and contribute to architecture, RFCs, and technical standards.

  • Mentor engineers and raise the technical bar through strong engineering practices, design reviews, and technical leadership.

What We’re Looking For

  • 14+ years of experience in platform engineering, infrastructure, or backend systems, ideally in a SaaS environment.

  • Strong experience building platform services, API gateways, service registries, control planes, or similar systems.

Who We Are

Atlan is building the context layer for enterprise AI. Enterprises are pouring money into AI and most of it dies in production because the AI does not understand the business context around the data. That is the problem Atlan solves.

Gartner has named context the defining issue in enterprise AI, and calls context graphs the essential infrastructure for AI agents, naming Atlan one of three vendors already building it. We are also the only vendor named a Leader across all four major Gartner and Forrester evaluations for data catalogs, data governance and metadata management, the foundation the context layer runs on.

Come build the infrastructure that AI runs on.

The Opportunity

AI applications are moving from prototypes to production, and the infrastructure underneath them is becoming increasingly complex.

We build and run the infrastructure behind our AI products: the cloud and Kubernetes platform they run on, the pipelines that ship code to production, and the observability that tells us when something breaks. We're also building AI agents that can operate that infrastructure themselves

We’re looking for a Staff Software Engineer who can work across these areas, build systems from the ground up, and think ahead about how they will behave at scale.

A key part of this role is building AI agents for infrastructure and engineering workflows. We’re looking for someone who has actually built and shipped agents or agentic systems that perform real work, not just used AI coding assistants or experimented with prompts.


What You Will Do?

  • Build reliable infrastructure at scale. Design and improve cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, compute, storage, and distributed systems.

  • Design for failure. Identify bottlenecks, failure modes, and operational risks before they become production issues.

  • Build safer deployments. Improve CI/CD, testing, rollout strategies, and deployment controls.

  • Build strong observability. Develop monitoring, alerting, tracing, and operational tooling that makes systems easier to understand and operate.

  • Improve infrastructure efficiency. Identify opportunities to improve performance, reliability, and cloud cost.

  • Build AI agents for infrastructure and engineering. Design and ship agents that can use tools and APIs, execute multi-step workflows, troubleshoot issues, or automate operational work.

  • Make agents safe to operate. Build the right evaluation, permissions, guardrails, observability, and failure handling around agents taking real actions.

  • Raise the engineering bar. Mentor engineers through architecture reviews, code reviews, technical discussions, and postmortems.

  • Share on-call ownership. Join the team’s on-call rotation, respond to production incidents, and turn what you learn into fixes, runbooks, and automation that reduce future pages.

What Makes You a Match?

  • You've built AI agents, not just used AI tools. You have shipped agentic systems that perform meaningful work and understand tools, state, workflows, evaluation, and guardrails.

  • You have strong infrastructure fundamentals. You understand distributed systems, cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes, networking, and production operations.

  • You've built systems through scale. You have taken infrastructure from relatively early stages to meaningful production scale and can talk about the trade-offs along the way.

  • You think about reliability by default. Failure modes, blast radius, operational complexity, and recovery are part of how you approach architecture.

  • You can debug across layers. You’re comfortable moving from application behaviour to Kubernetes, networking, and cloud infrastructure to find root causes.

  • You build rather than operate manually. Your instinct is to automate repetitive work and build tools that make engineering teams more effective.

  • You've built platforms other engineers build on. Package registries, artifact stores, CI systems or internal developer platforms all count.

  • You write things down. At staff level most of your influence comes through design docs and reviews.

Strong signals: Experience with multi-tenant SaaS, distributed systems, infrastructure automation, or production-grade AI agents. Experience with agent orchestration, tool use, evaluation, memory/state, or agent reliability is particularly valuable.

Our stack: AWS/EKS, Kubernetes, OpenTofu, FluxCD, Temporal, VictoriaMetrics, ClickHouse, Grafana, Go, and Rust. You don't need experience with all of these. Strong engineers from other backgrounds can pick them up quickly.

Why Atlan?

Joining Atlan means being part of a global movement to help data teams do their life’s best work. Here’s what you can expect:

  • Competitive Compensation: We benchmark at the top of the market and keep compensation simple: strong base salary, performance‑based variable pay, and impact‑driven equity (for most roles), so your total rewards grow in step with the value you create over time.

  • AI Native Culture: Atlan is where AI-native builders come to build the systems the future of work will run on. AI isn’t an add-on, it’s woven into how we build, think, and work every day, empowering every Atlanian to move faster and create a bigger impact.

  • Health & Wellness: From Day‑1 health, dental, vision, and mental health to flexible health stipends, we design benefits offerings that lead in each country we're in.

  • Flexible Time Off & Leave Policies: We trust you to own your energy: flexible time off and modern leave so you can unplug properly, support yourself and your loved ones, and come back ready to drive an impact.

  • Accelerated Growth & Learning: Develop at an uncommon velocity through cutting-edge tech, complex implementations, and an experienced team that values mastery.

  • Global, Remote-First, High-Trust: Work from anywhere with a diverse team across 15+ countries, in a trust-first, async environment that gives you true flexibility and ownership over how you work.

More About Us

Atlan is building the shared context layer that enterprises need so AI can operate on trusted, governed context. The conversation has moved from data leaders asking: “Can we trust the data in our stack?” to businesses asking: “Can we trust AI inside the business?”

We are the missing infrastructure for businesses becoming AI-forward - the connective tissue between their data stack, operational systems, and AI agents.

To learn more, visit www.atlan.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

Equal Opportunity Employer

Atlan is committed to building an inclusive, diverse, and authentic workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, disability, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital status, military or veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic.

Recruitment Fraud Alert
Your safety is important to us. Be cautious of recruiting emails from domains other than @atlan.com. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links — visit atlan.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

Atlan will never ask candidates to make a payment to apply for or obtain a position. We also will never request financial information, passwords, or other sensitive information from candidates. If you receive a communication that you believe may not be legitimate, do not send money or sensitive information. Please report the same on privacy@atlan.com.
